**What changed, and what it cost to find out**

<A behavioural change needs the measurement behind it. A mechanical one does not.>

**Verified**

- [ ] `node --test test/*.test.mjs`
- [ ] `python3 -m pytest .caw/hooks`
- [ ] Signed off (`git commit -s`)

**If a model wrote this patch**

Say what you verified by hand. The author of a change does not judge its tests — if the model
that wrote it also told you it works, that is one opinion, not two.

**Any claim about a population in this description** — "all callers updated", "no other usages" —
say how it was counted.
